user.title: Connect to C64 Ultimate
user.description: Enter the network details for your Commodore 64 Ultimate cartridge.

data_description.host: The local IP address of your Commodore 64 Ultimate (e.g. 192.168.1.50)
data_description.password: Optional — only required if you have set a Web Password under Network Settings on the Ultimate

display.title: Display Settings
display.description: Configure how the dashboard appears on the C64 screen.

data_description.heading: Title shown in the top bar of the C64 dashboard (max 38 characters)
data_description.filename: Filename written to the C64 SD card, e.g. HOMETO64.PRG
data_description.scan_interval: How often (in seconds) the PRG is rebuilt from current sensor values
data_description.auto_stop_minutes: Stop sending sensor data to the C64 after this many minutes. Set to 0 to never auto-stop. Use the 'Stop RAM Writes' button to stop immediately. Recommended: set this to a typical session length so that if you forget to stop manually, Home Assistant will not continue writing to C64 RAM indefinitely.

sensors.title: Choose Sensors
sensors.description: Select the Home Assistant entities you want to display on the C64. You can customise how each sensor is labelled on the next screen.

names.title: Sensor Display Names
names.description: These names appear on the C64 screen next to each sensor value. They have been pre-filled from each entity's friendly name — edit any you want to shorten or rename.

data_description.scan_interval: How often (in seconds) Home Assistant should write updated sensor values directly to C64 RAM. Lower values update the display more frequently but increase network traffic to your Ultimate cartridge.
data_description.auto_stop_minutes: Stop sending data after this many minutes. Set to 0 to never auto-stop.
data_description.num_pages: How many pages of sensors would you like? Each page can display up to 10 sensors with a custom heading.
data_description.auto_stop_min: Time in minutes before HA automatically stops sending sensor data to the C64. Useful if you leave the C64 on and walk away. Set to 0 to never auto-stop.

data_description.page_heading: Heading displayed at the top of this page on the C64 (max 37 chars).

page_names.title: Page {page_num} — Sensor Display Names
page_names.description: Customise how each sensor name appears on the C64 screen (max 20 chars).

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the C64 Ultimate. Check the IP address and that firmware 3.11+ is installed.
error.invalid_auth: Wrong Network Password. Check the password under Network Settings on your Ultimate.
error.unknown: Unexpected error — check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This C64 Ultimate is already configured.
